summary: Frontend-only validation of the newly added LIGHT theme + toggle for Arts Of Finance. Verified default light theme, toggle to dark, dark persistence after reload, toggle back to light, and light-theme rendering across 8 routes (/, /courses, /courses/options-trading, /blog, /faq, /contact, /about, /stock-market-classes-bhopal, /nonexistent-404-page). Verified contact lead form (name+phone) POST to /api/leads succeeds and opens a new tab to api.whatsapp.com/send with phone=917610714365 and prefilled text including 'Hi, I want to book a free demo class at Arts Of Finance.' plus Name/Phone lines. Verified dark-theme regression on home + /courses/options-trading (dark navy bg rgb(2,7,19), white text). Verified mobile 390px viewport shows theme-toggle-btn (visible instance next to hamburger) with no horizontal overflow. No white-on-white / invisible-text elements detected on any tested page in light theme.
critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetic: <html> in /app/frontend/public/index.html initially has class="dark" and the pre-paint script only ADDS "light" — resulting html.className is 'dark light lenis' at runtime. CSS uses html.light selector so light wins, but the coexistence of both class names is misleading. Recommend removing initial class="dark" or making pre-paint script explicitly set exactly one of the two classes.

LeadForm inputs use hardcoded 'text-white' and 'bg-ink-900/80'/'border-slate-700' classes — currently readable in light theme only because Tailwind color tokens are re-mapped via CSS variables. This works but means removing/adjusting the token remap in the future will break form contrast. Consider using semantic tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, border-border) for form fields for robustness.

contact-whatsapp-btn is a <button> without href. It works via JS window.open, but exposing it as an <a href={whatsAppUrl(...)}> would improve accessibility, SEO, right-click 'Copy link', and let assistive tech recognize the destination.
seed_data_creation: One TEST lead was submitted via /api/leads (name='TEST User Light', phone='9876543210') to confirm the WhatsApp handoff flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme system: html gets both 'dark' (from index.html) and 'light' (from pre-paint script + ThemeToggle) as classes; CSS relies on html.light selector; localStorage key is 'aof-theme' (default 'light'). Two theme-toggle-btn instances exist (desktop nav + mobile navbar) — always use .first or .locator().nth(...) when selecting. Contact WhatsApp handoff url pattern: https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=917610714365&text=<url-encoded lines>. Lead form data-testids: lead-form, lead-form-name, lead-form-phone, lead-form-email, lead-form-course, lead-form-mode, lead-form-experience, lead-form-callback, lead-form-message, lead-form-submit-btn.
